line: A heavy glass globe set down on stone, heavy and short, then a warm chime and a hiss of sand
why: the set-down that lies under all four landings (land-winter's takes 3 and 2), 60 cents lower for summer; when the knock has died, the kept ui-sound-on, a small chime, 700 cents lower as the warm chime; then the hiss of the cue's own take 1 as the sand, far under
